create_bulk_from_atoms: create a Bulk object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a bulk crystal structure
create_bulk_from_db_index: create a Bulk object by selecting a specific entry from the bulk database using its integer index
create_bulk_from_src_id: create a Bulk object by looking up a material in the bulk database using its source ID like mp-30
create_bulk_random: create a Bulk object by randomly sampling a bulk structure from the bulk database
get_slabs_from_bulk: get a list of possible slab surfaces from a Bulk object with a configurable max Miller index
